lines.text: Adonijah asks Bathsheba to request Abishag the Shunammite as his wife from King Solomon.
Solomon seats Bathsheba at his right hand, then sends Benaiah to strike down Adonijah.
Solomon sends Abiathar to his fields in Anathoth and banishes him from the priesthood, fulfilling the word spoken at Hebron.
Joab flees to the tent of the LORD, refuses to come out, and Benaiah kills him; Abishai takes his place over the army.

wrong_details.wrong: Abishai takes his place over the army
wrong_details.true: Benaiah son of Jehoiada is appointed in Joab's place over the army

lines.text: Shimei crosses the Kidron Valley to fetch his runaway slaves from Gath, and Solomon has Benaiah strike him down.
